learning_objective: 🎯 Let us explore the invisible magic called energy that makes everything move, glow, and work around us!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Energy is the superpower that makes things happen! We use energy from food to run and play, while cars use energy from fuel to drive.
The sun is the biggest source of energy for our Earth. It gives plants the light they need to grow and keeps our planet warm and bright.
Machines are special tools that make our work much easier. A simple slide at the park or a wheel on a bicycle are examples of simple machines!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Push and Pull Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Gather a few of your toys and try to move them across the floor by either giving them a gentle push or a soft pull to see how force works!

quick_recap: ⭐ Energy is essential for moving objects, growing, and doing any kind of work.
⭐ The sun is the most important and powerful source of energy for all living things.
⭐ We use simple machines every single day to make difficult jobs fast and easy.
